etf_flows.tracked_universe: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus the XRP sleeve of BITW
methodology: Daily flow is computed from day-over-day issuer-reported XRP holdings; it is not taken from issuer flow reports.
Flow-excluded funds contribute zero to the headline flow calculation.
BITW index rebalancing or fee accruals paid in XRP can be counted as flows.
Some historical rows are reconstructed from third-party daily estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
Issuer publication timing can move a creation/redemption into a later session.
etf_flows.interpretation: The average fund cost basis is an estimated aggregate acquisition-cost measure, not a market support level, investor cost basis or price target.

etf_flows.source: Alpha Finance five-fund XRP ETF tracker
etf_flows.limitation: Aggregator reports no fund list, AUM, holdings or fees on this page; issuer-file lineage and zero-flow policy require separate reconciliation. Not independent confirmation of other trackers.

etf_flows.source: Alpha Finance five-fund XRP ETF tracker
etf_flows.limitation: Different fund cohort and USD calculation from XRP Insights. Its page says fund list, AUM, holdings and fees are not published. Do not average with XRP Insights or treat zero as universal issuer confirmation.

source_independence.okx_and_kraken: Separate exchange publishers, but timestamps/currency pairs are not synchronized.
source_independence.swiftedge: Third-party perpetual-market aggregation; do not treat as an independent exchange source.
source_independence.kodexius: Third-party aggregation of public exchange contract data; overlapping upstream exchange feeds.
source_independence.alpha_finance: Single ETF flow aggregator; do not average with trackers sharing issuer-file inputs.
source_independence.trackwhale: Single vendor's selected public transfer sample; not independent confirmation of full exchange flows.
source_independence.xrp_insights: Issuer holdings are primary inputs, but flow calculations are a derived tracker series with excluded/reconstructed rows.
source_independence.glassnode: Independent analytics provider, but BTC measures must not be misapplied as XRP observations.
source_independence.macro_news: Reuters reports market consensus and geopolitics; official BLS PPI is the primary macro data source.

market_snapshot.raw_receipt_status: No byte-exact publisher response bytes were archived for these web observations; the artifact records URLs, provider vintages, extracted fields and explicit admission exclusions only.

limitations: Selected large-transfer sample, not complete exchange-wallet accounting.
Internal and exchange-to-exchange transfers are excluded from exchange flow totals.
Unknown-wallet transfers are not owner-attributed and do not prove selling.
notable_rows: A 16M XRP unknown-wallet-to-Bitso inflow at 09:37 UTC.
Three 10.3M XRP Binance-to-Binance rows are classified as internal rotations, not external exchange flows.
A 168.42M XRP transfer is the largest recorded transfer but is not identified as exchange flow.

institutional_and_regulatory_updates.event: XRPL institutional credit facilities and LendingProtocol collateral semantics
institutional_and_regulatory_updates.published_date: Page last updated about one month before this audit; live amendment page checked 2026-11-13
verified_facts: The documented Lending Protocol primitive uses uncollateralized fixed-term loans.
Single Asset Vaults aggregate lender assets and can hold XRP, trust-line tokens such as RLUSD, or Multi-Purpose Tokens.
Vault deposits are lender-pool funding, not borrower collateral.
The documentation says collateralized loans can be built with additional logic such as on-chain custodians; that is not the base Lending Protocol primitive.
The use-case requires both LendingProtocol and LendingProtocolV1_1 amendments.
institutional_and_regulatory_updates.activation_limitation: The XRPL Known Amendments page navigation labels Credit/Lending as Open for Voting, but its dynamic mainnet status widget did not render in this retrieval. The repository's last vote snapshot is dated November 8 and is not a current November 13 RPC observation. No current supermajority or activation claim is made.
institutional_and_regulatory_updates.xrp_relevance: Do not label XRPL LendingProtocol as a live XRP-collateralized lending market. XRP can be a vault asset; the base loan is uncollateralized. Actual collateralization requires separately evidenced custodian logic and activated amendments.

implemented_on_integration: 48 public source definitions: 43 hourly and three weekly CFTC endpoints; two non-commercial XRPL node endpoints excluded; 46 scheduled sources.
Per-run SHA-256 receipts and local hash chain; cross-run receipt-index continuity prototype.
Point-in-time SQLite feature store and snapshot validator.
CFTC Legacy Futures-Only and TFF parsers with distinct taxonomies.
Event timeline, source-independence grouping and scenario/counter-hypothesis assembler.
Four deterministic baselines: naive class prior, momentum sign, mean-reversion sign and Gaussian volatility normal.
Chronological walk-forward with purge/embargo, temporal temperature calibration and univariate PSI drift diagnostics.
Fail-closed forecast ledger with independent Ed25519 evaluator attestation requirement.
not_implemented_or_not_verified: No trained XRP-specific candidate model; walk-forward evaluates deterministic baselines only.
No mature synchronized historical dataset spanning spot, L2, derivatives, exchange flows, collateral and macro.
Current event registry has 73 curated events, zero non-null raw publisher SHA-256 receipts and zero model-eligible events.
No independent WORM store or trusted timestamp authority; raw receipt artifacts retain 90 days, per-run feature-store checkpoints seven days and daily archives 90 days.
No paired block-bootstrap confidence intervals or source-clustered uncertainty for model-versus-baseline Brier/log-loss differences.
Overlap-adjusted sample count does not remove residual serial dependence or common-source correlation.
PSI is univariate; multivariate and concept drift are not implemented.
No independent shadow cohort, trusted production evaluator key or measured candidate-model superiority.
Scheduled ingestion workflow is not on main and has no verified main-branch run.
